text:
pagerduty: P1 - spike in 502s and latency (p50 -> 600ms) for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 after today's blue/green push. Alerts: error-rate > 5% for 10m.
incident-bot: Created incident #INC-2026-079, paging on-call. Runbook: /playbooks/region-rollouts.md
anya (on-call): acked :point_up: seeing a jump in 502s from edge nodes, digging into router logs now
sam r: linking grafana panel: https://grafana/redwood/d/edge/region-overview?from=now-30m to show spike
lucy: I can see a drop in healthy backends in eu-west-1 in control-plane metrics around 12:14 UTC
eng-runtime: pushed the blue variant (v2.3.1) to 35% traffic in eu-west canary at 12:11 UTC. Rolling back to 0% now.
anya (on-call): initiating canary kill-switch (feature flag): `redwoodctl flags set region.eu-west.canary_enabled false`
prod-support: customers reporting degraded responses for writes and some 502s, ~120 affected requests/minute per our ingest
sre-lead: runbook step: confirm kill-switch applied, then route check `curl -I https://edge-eu.example/health` from probe hosts
anya (on-call): ran flag toggle, kill-switch returned 200 OK from flag service. Running internal canary probe...
eng-runtime: observed 200/OK from probes but router logs still show some 503s with upstream timeout to blue-backend pool: `upstream_timeout while reading response`
sam r: checking DNS weights: control plane shows eu-west weights: blue 25% / green 75% — flag flip should have set blue->0 but looks like a partial backfill due to stale region agent
lucy: agent logs from region-agent-2 show failed assignment ACK at 12:12: `timeout waiting for config` — agent retried and applied partial config (kept old weights)
anya (on-call): ok, mitigation plan: 1) force an explicit route map update to eu-west via control-plane API, 2) drain blue backends, 3) monitor customer impact
eng-runtime: applying forced route update: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/route/update -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","weights":{"blue":0,"green":100}}'`
prod-support: note to SAs: open a private incident note for impacted accounts and offer temporary bypass if needed
sre-lead: applying drain on blue pool: `kubectl scale deployment blue-backend -n eu-west --replicas=0` — doing controlled drain, using graceful 120s
anya (on-call): seeing error tail drop after drain begins, 502s trending down to 0.8% in last 5m. p50 down to 320ms
monitoring-bot: postmortem checklist started, capturing timeline and incident IDs.
sam r: handoff to night on-call in 40m. @sre-night please monitor DNS agent rollouts and confirm fix propagation to all edge agents
lucy: note: root cause looks like a transient config apply failure on region-agent-2 causing it to miss the kill-switch. Will file infra ticket to harden agent backoff/ack logic.
anya (on-call): adding customer impact: initial window ~12:10-12:25 UTC, ~15% of EU traffic saw increased errors, rough customer impact estimate 3k requests failed, no data loss reported, mainly short-lived errors.
prod-support: posting customer advisory draft to #customer-communications for review.
eng-runtime: creating rollback validation playbook entry: add forced route confirmation step and agent-health gating before traffic shifts.
sre-lead: closing incident channel when last metric stabilizes for 15m and no residual errors. Current status: mitigation in place, monitoring.
anya (on-call): leaving followup tasks: ticket for agent backoff, update runbook, customer postmortem. Handoff to @sam r for overnight watch — I'm OOO in 35m.
sam r: acked, will stay on top of it. Good job team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-079 status -> mitigated, severity -> P1, assignees -> eng-runtime, sre-lead, prod-support
